verdict.rationale: CSC's annual-report filing page says which filings it handles: annual reports, with 45-day advance reports, filed evidence uploaded to CSCNavigator, and Compliance Calendar events for annual reports and related obligations. The evidence does not say which states the filing service covers; the 50-state claims are for registered agent and SOP services and do not transfer. Nothing in the pack discloses pricing before purchase. Missing for 10: published state/jurisdiction coverage for annual report filings, any pricing or fee disclosure, an itemized list of covered filing types beyond annual reports.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it

citations.quote: You receive a report that outlines upcoming filings 45 days in advance, along with the good standing status of each entity that has a filing due in this window
The Compliance Calendar® automatically creates calendar events for annual reports and related filing obligations
